measurements.overhead_note: the per-call overhead measures at a few hundredths of a nanosecond while the spread ACROSS SAMPLES OF THE SAME ARM is larger than the difference between arms -- one arm even measured faster than its own control. So the honest statement is that the indirection costs two extra instructions per call and that its cost is not resolvable above scheduling noise at this iteration count, not that it costs 0.06 ns. A resolvable figure needs a quieter harness, which belongs with #68 where the call shape is what is under test.
measurements.benchmark_note: nanoseconds per call: the minimum of three samples over the stated iteration count, measured in the running release AFTER installation, so the mutable arms are dispatching to a replacement. The controls are non-selected functions marked vm:never-inline -- an inlined control is not a call, and would make the indirection look arbitrarily expensive. The accumulator is folded into the result so the loop cannot be eliminated.
measurements.aot_elf_delta_bytes_note: includes six replacement bodies the no-pragma control shakes away; not divisible by call sites
measurements.aot_elf_call_site_delta_note: measured 0 at this fixture size, which does not mean free: the emission replaces one pc-relative branch with a pool load, a compressed load and an indirect branch -- about two extra instructions per site, or roughly 8 bytes x 18 sites -- and ELF section alignment absorbs that entirely. A per-site byte figure needs a fixture large enough to cross an alignment boundary.
measurements.note: diagnostic only; no threshold is compared anywhere

falsification.description: the call site bypasses the dispatch cell and binds to the release implementation, while the descriptor still advances
falsification.why: a call permanently bound to the release implementation is the failure this whole issue exists to rule out; it must never end with the descriptor claiming a replacement the program is not running
falsification.observed: without the indirection: 8 optimizer escapes recorded, install refused (-3), the descriptor stays at AOT:v1, and the call still returns OLD -- caught at the install boundary rather than left to diverge

falsification.description: the expected strings match while no indirect call site was ever emitted
falsification.why: output strings are not evidence of a path; a run with no emitted indirect call site must be refused on the path evidence alone
falsification.observed: the bypass build emitted 0 indirect call sites for fn:work, and the condition reads False

falsification.description: the result of a mutable call is constant-folded, so every caller keeps the release answer although the call is made
falsification.why: the call is made, reaches the cell, and the caller still uses the release answer because the RESULT was folded
falsification.observed: 8 call sites emitted and the result observed is NEW; with the result folded back to OLD the verdict is NOT_ESTABLISHED

falsification.description: a selected declaration is inlined, so the caller never reaches the cell
falsification.why: an inlined copy of a selected declaration is a caller that never reaches the cell
falsification.observed: with every emitted call site removed the path condition reads False

falsification.description: the version advances with no implementation change
falsification.why: a version bump with no implementation change is not a replacement
falsification.observed: non-advancing version returned -3 (-3 = refused by StageReplacement)

falsification.description: the implementation changes with no version advance
falsification.why: an implementation change the version does not record leaves the evidence describing a program that is not running
falsification.observed: version and body move together: PATCH_CODE:v2 with NEW

falsification.why: a patch built against another release must not bind here
falsification.observed: wrong namespace returned -3 and the call still returns OLD

falsification.why: an unknown declaration must be refused, never created

condition_meanings.top_level_replacement_observed: did a precompiled top-level direct call return OLD, then NEW after installation, then NEW2 after a second installation?
condition_meanings.static_replacement_observed: the same for a precompiled static method call, proven independently?
condition_meanings.arms_are_independent: did installing one arm leave the other arm at its release answer, in both directions? (one arm cannot stand in for the other)
condition_meanings.no_restart_or_recompile: was it one process throughout -- same pid, one snapshot, no rebuild between the OLD and NEW observations?
condition_meanings.call_sites_traverse_the_mechanism: did the compiler emit indirect call sites through the dispatch cell for every replaced declaration? (zero means no caller can reach it, whatever the program printed)
condition_meanings.installation_is_descriptor_state: did the #66 version and kind advance, and does the dispatch cell still agree with the descriptor?
condition_meanings.identity_visible_in_evidence: does the record carry, structurally, the target DeclarationId, the REPLACEMENT DeclarationId, the release namespace, the ABI, and kind+version before and after -- rather than a Function-name diagnostic?
condition_meanings.release_implementation_still_represented: after replacement, can the descriptor still name what the release shipped, for rollback and version history?
condition_meanings.unrelated_declarations_unchanged: did a selected-but-not-replaced declaration and a non-selected one both keep their release answers?
condition_meanings.refusals_before_visible_mutation: were unknown id, wrong release namespace, ABI mismatch and a non-advancing version each refused with the release answer intact?
condition_meanings.repeated_calls_stay_replaced: does calling again after installation still reach the replacement?
condition_meanings.required_falsifications_detected: did every required falsification actually fire?
condition_meanings.call_latency_measured_numerically: are direct AND static call latencies real numbers from a running program, each with a never-inlined non-mutable control? Prose saying a thing was not measured is not a measurement.
condition_meanings.size_measurements_recorded: are the code-size and registry measurements present? No threshold is compared; absence is the only failure.
condition_meanings.build_provenance_bound: were the binaries that produced this evidence built from the exact MAOT source bytes the record names?
condition_meanings.target_architecture_recorded: does the record say which architecture the lowering was proven on?
condition_meanings.cold_and_hot_observed: does a heavily-executed call site observe the replacement too, measured after a million iterations rather than inferred from the benchmark running a lot?
condition_meanings.t0_linkage_exact_and_unpromoted: does the record link exactly the demonstrated modes -- direct, AOT, cold+hot, arm64 -- while leaving both whole rows UNMODELED?

verdict.verdict_rule: arm64_aot_direct_static_vertical_slice == ESTABLISHED iff every condition above holds AND no blocking finding was raised. issue_67_closure == READY iff that AND no acceptance item is unmet. Both are conjunctions; no count, ratio or threshold is compared anywhere in this module, and no outcome string is reachable unconditionally. The two are separate because a true technical result must not be able to carry an untrue milestone claim.
not_claimed: Proven on arm64 only. The lowering is in flow_graph_compiler_arm64.cc and no other architecture has one.
No #64 row is promoted. #67 covers the `direct` dispatch mode of EB-01 and EB-02 under AOT; each row also requires tearoff_pre, tearoff_post and dynamic, across JIT and AOT. See t0_row_linkage.
No virtual, interface or super dispatch. #69 owns those.
No universal no-bypass claim. The posture here is the blunt rule that a selected declaration is neither inlined nor constant-folded through; #68 owns the real optimizer contract.
The replacement implementation is another AOT-compiled Dart body present in the release image, selected by descriptor. Delivering an externally-built body is #72/#77.
No additions, no class-shape work, no transaction architecture beyond what #66 exposes, and no production CLI or package format.
